<thought>To create the required dataset, I will retrieve polymorph data for up to 40 nitride compositions using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool with the specified energy and count limits. This will store the JSON files in a directory for later consolidation and model training.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": [
    "AlN","GaN","InN","TiN","VN","ZrN","HfN","CrN","MoN","NbN",
    "Si3N4","BN","ScN","Y3N5","Mg3N2","Ca3N2","Sr3N2","Ba3N2","LaN","CeN",
    "PrN","NdN","SmN","GdN","DyN","ErN","TmN","YbN","LuN","FeN",
    "CoN","NiN","CuN","ZnN","AgN","CdN","PbN","Sn3N4","Ge3N4","Al3N5"
  ],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_nitrides_trial_13/polymorph_data"
}</action_input>
